Task 1: Querying an API and a Tidy-Style Function
Use GET() from the httr package to return information about a topic in the news.

getresult <- GET("https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?q=Dolly%20Parton&from=2026-09-01&language=en&pageSize=50&apiKey=2c43d850c570494389b660ffaf1757db")

Parse what is returned.

parsedresult <- fromJSON(rawToChar(getresult$content))
newsdata <- as_tibble(parsedresult$articles)

Write a function that allows the user to query this API.

querynews <- function(subject, time, key){
  
  getresult <- GET(paste0("https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?q=", 
                          gsub(" ", "%20", subject), 
                          "&from=", 
                          time, 
                          "&language=en&pageSize=50&apiKey=", 
                          key))
  
  parsedresult <- fromJSON(rawToChar(getresult$content))
  return(as_tibble(parsedresult$articles))
}

Examples using the function:

key <- "2c43d850c570494389b660ffaf1757db"

querynews("Nashville International Airport", "2026-09-05", key)
